typography.instructions: Import 'Manrope' and 'Public Sans' from Google Fonts. Use Manrope for all Headings to give a geometric, industrial feel. Use Public Sans for body text and especially data tables for maximum legibility. Ensure Chinese character fallback (Noto Sans SC).

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 rounded-none h-11 px-8 uppercase tracking-wide font-bold text-sm transition-all shadow-sm
buttons.secondary: border border-input bg-background hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground rounded-none h-11 px-8 uppercase tracking-wide font-medium text-sm transition-all
buttons.outline: border-2 border-primary/20 hover:border-accent hover:text-accent rounded-none h-11 px-6 font-mono text-xs uppercase

cards.product: group relative border border-border bg-card hover:shadow-lg transition-all duration-300 overflow-hidden
cards.feature: p-6 border border-border/50 bg-gradient-to-br from-card to-card/50 hover:border-accent/50 transition-colors

inputs.default: rounded-none border-input focus:ring-1 focus:ring-accent focus:border-accent bg-background

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-md bg-white/70 dark:bg-slate-900/70 border-b border-white/20 dark:border-slate-800/50
visual_enhancers.tech_lines: Decoration using 1px lines with accent color to simulate fiber optics

hero_slider.alt: Glowing fiber optic cables in macro view
Data center server room with blue illumination

images.icons: Use 'lucide-react' for all UI icons. Use 'Square' variants for a technical look (e.g. SquareActivity instead of Activity).

universal_rules: Use 'Manrope' for all headings and 'Public Sans' for body.
Implement a Light/Dark toggle in the header. Default to Light mode for professional look.
Ensure all borders are 1px and subtle (slate-200 in light, slate-800 in dark).
Buttons should be rectangular (rounded-none or rounded-sm) to emphasize industrial precision.
Use a 'Sheet' component for mobile filters.
Do not use generic 'teal' colors. Stick to the defined Slate/Cyan palette.

homepage.structure: Hero Slider -> Brand Value Props (Grid) -> Featured Products (Carousel) -> Categories (Bento Grid) -> About/Global Reach -> Newsletter
homepage.hero_style: Full height minus header (h-[calc(100vh-64px)]). Dark, immersive even in light mode.

catalog.structure: Sidebar (Filters: Category Tree, Brands, Tech Specs) + Main Content (Sort Bar, Product Grid, Pagination)
catalog.card_style: Minimalist. Image top, Model Number (Mono font), Title, Price/Quote Button. Hover effect: Border glow.

product_detail.structure: Breadcrumbs -> Two Column Layout (Gallery Left, Info Right) -> Tabs (Specs, Downloads, Related) -> Related Products
product_detail.key_features: Sticky 'Get Quote' bar on mobile. Detailed technical table with zebra striping.
